titleLines: Rooms overlooking Lake Toya with views of the four seasons.
priceHighlight: From ¥15,000/night per person, incl. dinner & breakfast
description: Alongside Japanese- and Western-style rooms, we also offer large banquet halls for bigger groups.
Please spend a relaxing time overlooking Lake Toya and Mt. Yotei from the room, while looking at Lake Toya, which changes its expression every season.
